hook: Gym lo weights eththgalani undha, kani bhayama?
caption:
Gym lo weights eththadam modalupettalani undha? Bhayam vadhileseyandi! Proper form tho light weights nundi start cheyandi, chala easy ga untundhi. Ee reel mee friend ki share cheyandi!

#TeluguFitness #BeginnerWorkout #StrengthTraining #GymMotivation #HealthyLife #TeluguHealth #FitnessJourney #WorkoutTips
poster_caption:
🏋️‍♂️ Tired of working out hard with zero muscle gains? Most beginners make the mistake of random training instead of following a structured system.

Here is how to fast-track your strength safely:
• Master foundational compound movements
• Apply progressive overload consistently every week
• Never skip the mandatory 48-hour recovery window

📌 Save this guide for your daily fitness routine!

#StrengthTraining #FitnessTips #BeginnerWorkout #MuscleBuilding #WorkoutRoutine #FitnessScience #HealthyHabits #Arovia360
